title: Causal Role of Training Data Ordering in Emergent Misalignment

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if data ordering matters, curriculum design becomes a cheap mitigation for emergent misalignment without changing dataset content. Directly actionable and low-cost to implement.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses the existing insecure-code dataset with three different orderings. Fine-tuning is standard. The only variable is shuffle order. Alignment probes from Betley et al. exist. Very accessible to beginners with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three conditions (random, misalignment-first, misalignment-last), same dataset, same model, same probes. Single clean experiment with one variable. Well within 30 hours.
